test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 1 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. You have to consider these statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts. Decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statement.

**Statements:**

All bins are plastics

Some plastics are nylon

Some nylons are green

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some nylons are plastics

(II) All plastics are bins

(III) Some greens are nylons

options.text: Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a96dce596ac920aad6aa679b581a2444eef4534deaa35a1990f57ac1db68714e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some nylons are plastics → Follow (As some plastics are nylon. As some part of plastics is common with nylon, therefore it is true.)

II. All plastics are bins → Does not follow (As all bins are plastics. So it is possible but not definite.)

III. Some greens are nylons → Follow (As some nylons are green. As some parts of nylons are common with greens, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusions I and III follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
